title: The Influence of Short Selling on Negative Press Coverage of Firms
authors: Robert M. Bushman; Jedson Pereira Pinto
eligible_reason: Reg SHO pilot: all pilot firms treated on the same date (May 2005) with the pilot ending for everyone in July 2007 (single cohort). Main regressions include two treatment regressors (treat = sho x during, poss = sho x post) with firm and quarter FE; most columns add time-varying firm controls; some use entropy-balancing or matching pweights. Single-date design, not staggered adoption.
design_notes: BP_SS_replicateAllRegressions.do: reghdfe css90 treat poss pos sho dur [controls], a(gvkey dateq) cluster(gvkey); Table 3 col 1 restricts to pre/during. Event version: sho x year dummies with controls. Tables 7-8: short-interest and return regressions on daily/monthly panels.
excluded_specs_summary: All Tables 3-10: single adoption date; during/post treatment pair; time-varying controls in most columns; ebalance (_webal) and matching (_weight) pweights in robustness.
data_provenance_note: Analysis files with RavenPack-derived sentiment and Compustat/CRSP/IBES variables shipped.
